prompt: Order the body of `spawn_group`, which starts a command as the leader of its own process group so a whole job can be signalled later. Both parent and child call `setpgid`. One line does not belong.
explain: Both sides call `setpgid(child, child)` because either could run first; whichever goes first wins and the other is harmless. Waiting inside `spawn_group` would stop the shell from returning to its prompt and make the job foreground only.
